items.title: Risky Chinese Electric Buses Spark Aussie Gov't Review
items.description: Deployed across Australia and Europe, China's electric buses are vulnerable to cybercriminals and sport a remote connection some worry the Chinese state could activate.

items.title: Okta SSO accounts targeted in vishing-based data theft attacks
items.description: Okta is warning about custom phishing kits built specifically for voice-based social engineering (vishing) attacks. BleepingComputer has learned that these kits are being used in active attacks to steal Okta SSO credentials for data theft. [...]

items.title: Fortinet Firewalls Hit With Malicious Configuration Changes
items.description: Automated infections of potentially fully patched FortiGate devices are allowing threat actors to steal firewall configuration files.
